solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Hit twice, your health!

indicators.note: twice means the word for hit is written down two times in a row

parts.note: to chin someone is to punch them on the chin

explanation.surface: A boxer lands the same blow two times, then raises a glass to toast the opponent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hit' gives CHIN (to chin someone is to punch them), and 'twice' writes it down again.
explanation.definitionFit: Chin-chin is an old-fashioned drinking toast, used just like saying cheers.

clue.text: One of the cats, each with the cuckoo

indicators.note: cuckoo means crazy, so the letters of each and the go mad and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A big cat shares space with a cuckoo bird, each of them in turn.
explanation.walkthrough: Pool the letters of EACH and THE, then rearrange them as 'cuckoo' says.
explanation.definitionFit: The cheetah is a large spotted wild feline, famous as the fastest land animal.

clue.text: Get into ground, Milan team

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to bury, as a body in a grave
second meaning: ... Milan, the Italian football club

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a football team arriving at its stadium; 'ground' is the earth of a grave.
explanation.definitionFit: To inter is to bury a corpse, and Inter is the usual short name for the football club Internazionale.

clue.text: One applauding directors — one of those on film set?

definitions.text: one of those on film set?

parts.note: a clapper is someone who claps
a company's directors make up its board

explanation.surface: Someone claps the directors, perhaps at the end of filming.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as a description rather than a dictionary synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: A clapperboard is the hinged slate snapped shut at the start of each take when shooting a movie.

clue.text: Picture in my attic getting exhibited, initially

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of each of the words before it is taken

explanation.surface: A painting stored in the attic is finally put on show, recalling Dorian Gray's portrait.
explanation.definitionFit: An image is a picture or likeness, such as a painting or photograph.

clue.text: Work in shop usually

indicators.note: in signals that the letters sit inside the words shop usually

explanation.surface: Someone describes their usual job: working in a shop.
explanation.definitionFit: An opus is a work, especially a musical composition or artistic creation.

clue.text: Apostle endlessly touring dead flat land

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the shortened name goes around the other piece
endlessly means the last letter of the apostle's name is cut off

parts.note: Paul is the apostle St Paul
the late someone is a person who has died

explanation.surface: An apostle on his travels crosses a lifeless, level landscape.
explanation.walkthrough: St Paul is the apostle meant; 'dead' is the late, as in the late king.
explanation.definitionFit: A plateau is an area of high, level ground, a raised plain.

clue.text: Fish reeked

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a small silvery food fish
second meaning: past tense of smell, as in gave off a stench

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a fish that stank; smelt is a British past tense of smell.
explanation.definitionFit: The smelt is a small edible sea fish, and smelt also means gave off an odour.

clue.text: Wife as old as us imbibing cider primarily — confidence gained from that?

indicators.note: imbibing means drinking in, so the other letter goes inside

parts.note: 'my old dutch' is Cockney slang for one's wife
someone as old as us is our age

indicators.note: primarily means the first letter of cider

explanation.surface: An elderly wife sips cider, and the drink gives her boldness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'imbibing' puts C, the first letter of cider, between DUTCH and OUR AGE. Dutch for a wife comes from Cockney rhyming slang (duchess of Fife).
explanation.definitionFit: Dutch courage is the boldness that comes from drinking alcohol, so 'that' points back to the cider.

clue.text: More Artex plastered

indicators.note: plastered means drunk, so the letters of Artex reel into a new order

explanation.surface: More of the textured Artex coating is spread over a ceiling.
explanation.walkthrough: Artex is a British brand of textured ceiling coating; 'plastered' looks like decorating but means drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Extra means additional, an amount beyond what is usual.

clue.text: Grown-up holding a service, finally — worship

indicators.note: holding means the first piece contains the next

parts.note: a grown-up is an adult

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of service

explanation.surface: An adult attends a church service, ending in worship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holding' puts A inside ADULT to give ADULAT, then 'finally' adds E from the end of service.
explanation.definitionFit: To adulate is to praise or admire someone excessively, a kind of hero worship.

clue.text: Something black that's so long, shortened

indicators.note: shortened means the farewell loses its final letter

parts.note: ta-ra is an informal northern British goodbye, like so long

explanation.surface: A black thing that took so long is finally cut down.
explanation.walkthrough: Ta-ra is a British colloquial goodbye; 'shortened' removes its last A.
explanation.definitionFit: Tar is a thick, dark, sticky substance distilled from coal or wood, used on roads.

clue.text: Able to look forward, reinspect changes

indicators.note: changes means the letters of reinspect are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: An inspector checks again and finds things have changed, as foreseen.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone prescient has foresight, knowing about events before they happen.

clue.text: Keen to have first of automobiles taken out of country

indicators.note: taken out of means that letter is removed from the country's name

parts.note: Hungary is the central European country

indicators.note: first of means the opening letter of automobiles

explanation.surface: Someone is eager to have the first cars exported from a country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first of' gives A from automobiles, which is 'taken out of' HUNGARY.
explanation.definitionFit: Hungry can mean eager or longing for something, as in hungry for success.

clue.text: What babies need: rest before food

indicators.note: before means the rest comes ahead of the food in the answer

parts.note: a nap is a short rest
pies are food

explanation.surface: Babies need a sleep first and then something to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: Nappies are what Americans call diapers.
explanation.definitionFit: Nappies, the British word for diapers, are the absorbent pants infants wear before toilet training.

clue.text: Edges on specific frilled collar for back of neck

indicators.note: edges on a word are its first and last letters, here of specific

parts.note: a ruff is a starched pleated collar of Elizabethan times

explanation.surface: A tailor describes the trims on a specific frilled collar for the back of the neck.
explanation.definitionFit: The scruff is the nape, the part of the neck at the back, as in held by the scruff.

clue.text: Aim of driver, quite some distance?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a golfer driving off the tee aims for the closely mown strip of a golf hole
second meaning: a ..., quite a long way off

explanation.walkthrough: 'driver' suggests a motorist, but it is a golfer with a driver club; the second reading splits the answer into two words.
explanation.definitionFit: The fairway is the mown area between tee and green on a golf course, and a fair way is a considerable distance.

clue.text: Tidying mop up, trim unplanned

indicators.note: tidying means rearranging things, so these letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A spontaneous clean-up: mopping the floor and trimming things on a whim.
explanation.definitionFit: Impromptu means done without preparation or rehearsal, improvised on the spot.

clue.text: Cage up-ended into it, clumsy

indicators.note: into means the reversed word goes inside it
up-ended in a down clue means the word is turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure for animals, a cage

explanation.surface: Someone clumsily knocks a cage over, tipping it into something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up-ended' turns PEN into NEP, which goes 'into' IT.
explanation.definitionFit: Inept means lacking skill, awkward or incompetent.

clue.text: One kept in receptacle, old instrument

indicators.note: kept in means the numeral is placed inside the container

parts.note: a pan is a receptacle, a vessel for cooking
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: An old instrument has been stored inside a box.
explanation.definitionFit: The piano is a keyboard instrument whose hammers strike strings.

clue.text: "The greatest" so-called country without leader

indicators.note: without leader means the country's name drops its first letter

parts.note: Mali is the West African country

explanation.surface: A self-styled great one rules a country that has no head.
explanation.walkthrough: Muhammad Ali, the boxer, called himself 'The Greatest'.
explanation.definitionFit: The heavyweight boxer Muhammad Ali famously proclaimed himself the greatest, and it became his nickname.

clue.text: Vessel that has a gold tap, short

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry

indicators.note: short means the word tap loses its last letter

explanation.surface: A ship with a golden tap that is too small.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessel' suggests a ship or a container but means a blood vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: The aorta is the main artery carrying blood away from the heart, a blood vessel.

clue.text: African country I rate built by queen

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen's monogram

indicators.note: built means constructed, so the letters of I rate are put together in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone praises an African nation that a queen built.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface puts the queen last, but ER comes first in the answer; 'by' merely links.
explanation.definitionFit: Eritrea is a nation in the Horn of Africa, on the Red Sea coast.

clue.text: Missing head, slender dart

indicators.note: missing head means the word loses its first letter

parts.note: slender means narrow

explanation.surface: A thin dart has lost its point.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrow is a pointed missile shot from a bow, much like a dart.

clue.text: Dip toe in Hampshire river

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to try something out tentatively
second meaning: the ..., a river in Hampshire famous for trout fishing

explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures paddling in a river; Hampshire is a county in southern England.
explanation.definitionFit: To test is to try something out cautiously, and the Test is a chalk-stream river in Hampshire.

clue.text: Herb stood before queen

indicators.note: before means the first piece comes ahead of the second

parts.note: rose means stood up
Mary is the name of several queens, such as Mary I

explanation.surface: A herb stood up in the presence of a queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Rosemary is an aromatic evergreen shrub whose leaves are used in cooking.
